The main takeaway from our work is that
the transverse variations ahead of the apex shock are significant and must be accounted for to accurately determine the flowfield and aerodynamic characteristics of the body.
the far wake flowfield is a strong function of the shock apex location, and the flow properties are significantly different in the attached and detached cases.
